text:
Maya Chen: heads-up — running a compact access snapshot for infra + data-prod now. goal: find ownerless admins, stale grants, cross-project KMS exposures. will upload CSV here.
Carlos Rivera: ETA?
Maya Chen: ~2h. using `./tools/iam-query --org redwood --groups infra,data-prod --include-kms --format csv`
Nate Brooks: please include service-account impersonation chains (we missed those last sweep).
Samir Patel: can we auto-ticket findings and include `justification_age` so product owners see stale approvals? /remediate-bot could create PRs.
Elle Johnson: quick policy Q — workload identity SAs with project-editor should be classified as elevated?
Maya Chen: yes. classify any SA with project-level editor/owner as `elevated`. separate flag for WI.
sec-automation-bot: scan started for groups infra,data-prod. est 9m.
Carlos Rivera: playbook for ownerless admin roles? create ticket + 72h? temp removal after?
Maya Chen: suggested playbook: 1) auto-ticket to security queue, owner unset; 2) notify team owners list; 3) 72h response window; 4) if no owner, perform temp-prune; 5) monitor 24h and roll back if failures; 6) escalate to sec-oncall.
Carlos Rivera: ack
Nate Brooks: attach redacted auditlog snippets to tickets: https://logs.redwood.internal/access/1703005678
Maya Chen: will add auditlink and `risk_reason` column + CSV upload.
Samir Patel: I'll add a safe revert command and include it in the ticket template: `iam-grant --ticket $T --principal $P --role $R --reason "revert temp-prune"`
Maya Chen: tagging sec-oncall @Elle Johnson for coverage
Elle Johnson: cover OK; will watch for alerts during sweep window.
sec-automation-bot: scan complete. results: 51 elevated principals, 2 ownerless admin bindings, 9 stale grants (>180d). CSV: https://files.redwood/priv-snapshots/1703005678.csv
Carlos Rivera: found one cross-project KMS grant to a partner project; include kms-rotation team on that ticket.
Maya Chen: added kms-rotation watchers. scheduling low-blast-radius canary prune next Tue 08:00 UTC to validate. will notify infra, analytics, and oncall. thanks all :pray:
